metadata.name: Tile Band
metadata.description: A decorative or dividing strip of hand-painted Goan tile motifs (azulejo blue-and-white or majolica cobalt/lemon/leaf), seeded so the same page always paints the same tiles, with a quiet line-art, warm glazed, or playful touch-reactive register.
